base_anchors.source_quality: Recall and partial notebook review, approximate and not independently audited
base_anchors.authoritative_form: APF3_Ficha_Propietario_Baylon.docx, version declaring Rildo as respondent
base_anchors.source_policy: Use only this owner declaration and the user's denominator clarification. The earlier wholly hypothetical completed form is excluded as evidence or calibration input.
base_anchors.overdue_grant_condition: Prior abono or payment agreement with owner review; exceptions not quantified
base_anchors.privacy: Aggregate source parameters only; no customer identities, signatures or real snapshots

base_simulation.population_interpretation: Finite example roster per history, not a real fixed population
base_simulation.schedule: Rotate an absent group of 3 among 12 example clients each week; the inherited calendar is a scenario assumption, not a measurement of real traffic
base_simulation.amount_distribution: Inherited truncated lognormal with S/20 log-location, then the amount_policy above
base_simulation.latent_lateness: Inherited Beta heterogeneity, an explicit unmeasured hypothesis
base_simulation.partial_payment_probability: 10/48, an assumption from the owner-reviewed denominator
base_simulation.late_delay_distribution: Inherited truncated lognormal rounded to integers 1..15; shape unmeasured
base_simulation.payments: Every generated credit has a planned complete payment possibly after cutoff; permanent loss rate unknown and not invented
base_simulation.sales: Only linked granted-credit sales are modeled; cash-sale volume not quantified
base_simulation.unknowns: Population, distribution shapes, warmup length, stationarity, time distributions, and exact weekly frequencies remain assumptions

amount_policy.source: Owner review: whole soles or .50 are normal examples; exact product-price totals may be kept
amount_policy.generation: Draw the inherited truncated lognormal anchor, then with an explicit scenario probability of 0.75 quantize to nearest 0.50 with Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; otherwise retain the exact two-decimal amount
amount_policy.mean_pen: Not owner-measured; typical S/20 remains a log-location assumption, not a proven mean
amount_policy.certainty: The 0.75/0.25 split is a scenario assumption, not owner-declared frequencies

payment_time_policy.future_or_simultaneous_payments: Never used as settled before evaluation
payment_time_policy.due_cutoff: 20:00 on the contractual due date; pending balance after that is late

client_pool_policy.weekly_distinct_recipients: About 9 and varying week to week
client_pool_policy.source_meaning: Customers can change week to week; 12 is a finite example roster, not population knowledge
client_pool_policy.rotation: Inherited 3-group rotation with 9 weekly scheduled examples; never pooled as simultaneous branches

calibration.effective_pending_balance_policy: Reject evaluation for new credit whenever any remaining principal is positive, including debt not yet due. Partial payments and agreements do not restore eligibility. Full settlement must be observed strictly before evaluation; it resumes eligibility only.
